name: Mathiel's Armor
summary: "Mathiel's Armor" marks the completion of an armorsmithing effort undertaken by Mathiel in the Warrior's Terrace of Darnassus. By combining his own night elven craftsmanship with innovative dwarven metalworking methods devised by Furen Longbeard, Mathiel reforges exotic materials into protective battle gear. The quest represents a fruitful blending of allied traditions in service of Alliance warriors.

sections.title: A Blend of Crafts
sections.body: Night elven armorers traditionally favor methods honed over millennia, relying on harmony with nature, supple leathers, or delicately worked metals. However, the exchange between the night elves and the Eastern Kingdoms has prompted master smiths like Mathiel to experiment. By incorporating newly devised techniques from the Ironforge armorer Furen Longbeard, Mathiel manages to meld dwarven metallurgy with elven artistry.

sections.title: Exotic Components
sections.body: Forging this resilient armor required sunscorched eggshells gathered from the Highperch wyvern nests of Thousand Needles. By rendering these sun-hardened shells into lacquer and applying Furen's heat-treatment formulas, Mathiel successfully created a resilient breastplate designed to withstand brutal frontline combat.

faq.answer: Mathiel is a skilled night elf armorsmith stationed in the Warrior's Terrace within Darnassus. He works closely with fellow craftsmen across the Alliance, testing new concepts developed by allies such as Furen Longbeard.

Furen Longbeard is a master dwarven armorsmith residing in Stormwind City. Known for inventing innovative techniques to temper and forge specialized armor plates, he regularly shares instructions and designs with allied smiths throughout the Alliance.

faq.q: What materials were used to forge the armor?
aliases: what is mathiel's armor made of
faq.answer: The armor is forged using sunscorched eggshells gathered below the Highperch wyvern nests in Thousand Needles, which Mathiel reinforces and shapes using Furen Longbeard's specific smithing procedures.

faq.q: Why is an elf using dwarven techniques?
faq.answer: Alliance smiths frequently share knowledge to equip their fighters against escalating threats. While night elf smithing is renowned for finesse and durability, dwarven innovations provide exceptional hardening methods that Mathiel gladly incorporated.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: The quest begins and completes at the forge located in the Warrior's Terrace of Darnassus on the island of Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is the previous quest in this chain?
faq.answer: This quest immediately follows 'Sunscorched Shells', wherein an adventurer must travel to the far reaches of Kalimdor to acquire tough chitinous shells suitable for Mathiel's craft.

angles.text: For Alliance warriors, this quest chain produces sturdy breastplate armor forged through the combined metallurgical wisdom of both Darnassus and Ironforge.
The project serves as a shining example of inter-factional crafting, proving that rigid dwarven tempering can harmonize with elegant night elven forge craft.
Mathiel and Furen's collaboration illustrates the practical military benefits of the Alliance, uniting distant peoples through shared trade and mutual defense.
